newsitem.title: USA: Paul Harris January same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Paul Harris January same-store sales up.

text.p: Paul Harris Stores Inc said Thrursday its comparable store sales rose 30 percent in January from a year ago.
Net sales for the four weeks of January 1997 rose two percent to $7.7 million versus $7.6 million in January 1996, which included five weeks of operations.

"Comps were very strong due to clearance sell-offs, and there was more traffic in the stores because the weather was much better this January than in 1996," said Charlotte Fischer, chairman, president and chief executive.
"Late in the month, new spring products were introduced and sold very well, which also enhanced our positive comp store sales," Fischer said.
Paul Harris is a specialty retailer of private-label women's casual wear.
